short.title: Gianpietro Marchetti, Juventus Defender, Dies at 78

beats.text: Juventus Serie A champion Gianpietro Marchetti has died. He was born in Rudiano, Italy, in 1948.
The defender began his journey in the Italian league, playing for Juventus during the 1971–72 season.
He reached the pinnacle of the sport, winning back-to-back Serie A titles in 1971–72 and 1972–73.
His career remains a part of the club's history, leaving behind a legacy of two Serie A honours.
